# FinCalcHub Marketing

> Professional financial calculator suite with live crypto conversion, investment, tax, and business tools.

## About

FinCalcHub Marketing (https://fincalchub.xyz) is a comprehensive web application providing 13 professional financial calculators. All calculations run 100% client-side in the browser — no data is sent to any server. Crypto prices update every 30 seconds via the CoinGecko public API.

## Tools Available

### 1. Real-Time Crypto & Fiat Converter
- Converts Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Solana (SOL) to 8 fiat currencies
- Supported currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, PKR, INR, AED, CAD, AUD
- Live market rates via CoinGecko API with 24h change indicators
- Auto-refresh every 30 seconds with offline fallback rates

### 2. Compound Interest Calculator
- Calculates future value with principal, rate, time, and compounding frequency
- Supports monthly contributions
- Visual breakdown of principal, contributions, and interest earned

### 3. SIP Investment Planner
- Systematic Investment Plan calculator for mutual fund investors
- Calculates maturity value, total invested, and wealth gained
- Shows invested vs returns breakdown

### 4. Income Tax Calculator (Pakistan)
- Progressive tax slabs for Pakistani tax year
- Supports salaried individuals and business/self-employed categories
- Calculates annual tax, monthly deduction, effective rate, and take-home pay

### 5. Savings Goal Calculator
- Determines monthly savings needed to reach a financial goal
- Factors in investment returns and current savings
- Shows total savings and interest earned

### 6. Retirement Planning Calculator
- Inflation-adjusted retirement corpus calculation
- Factors current age, retirement age, monthly expenses, and life expectancy
- Calculates required monthly savings and years to retirement

### 7. Profit Margin Calculator
- Calculates profit, margin (profit as % of revenue), and markup (profit as % of cost)
- Visual breakdown of cost vs profit

### 8. Freelancer Hourly Rate Calculator
- Determines ideal hourly/daily rate for freelancers
- Factors desired income, business expenses, billable hours, tax rate, vacation days, and profit margin
- Calculates working days per year and minimum revenue needed

### 9. SaaS CAC & LTV ROI Engine
- Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Lifetime Value (LTV) calculator
- Calculates LTV:CAC ratio, ROI, payback period, and gross margin
- Key metrics: net revenue per customer, annual revenue, break-even customers

### 10. E-Commerce Net Profit & Markup Suite
- Calculates true profit after all hidden costs
- Factors: product cost, shipping, platform fees, payment gateway fees, ad spend
- Shows cost breakdown per unit and net margin

## Technical Details

- **Tech Stack**: Pure HTML, CSS (Tailwind CSS), JavaScript
- **Hosting**: Deployed on Netlify at fincalchub.xyz
- **API**: CoinGecko public API for live crypto prices
- **Privacy**: 100% client-side, no data collection
- **PWA**: Progressive Web App with install support
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first design with custom xs: breakpoint

## File Structure

```
fincalchub.xyz/
├── index.html          # Main calculator suite (13 tools)
├── tools.html          # Tools overview page
├── blog.html           # Blog page
├── faq.html            # FAQ page
├── privacy.html        # Privacy policy
├── terms.html          # Terms of service
├── readme.html         # HTML README
├── robots.txt          # Search engine directives
├── sitemap.xml         # XML sitemap
├── manifest.json       # PWA manifest
├── _redirects          # Netlify redirects
├── vercel.json         # Vercel config
└── llms.txt            # LLMs.txt for AI discoverability
```

## Key Features

- **Live Crypto Prices**: Real-time Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana prices in 8 currencies
- **Multi-Currency Support**: USD, EUR, GBP, PKR, INR, AED, CAD, AUD
- **Instant Calculations**: All calculations update in real-time as you type
- **Responsive Design**: Works perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop
- **Offline Support**: Fallback rates if CoinGecko API is unavailable
- **No Data Collection**: 100% client-side, privacy-focused
